evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

CA.rationale: Content coordinates and an explicit origin/processing-kind (command_estimate/feedback_through) are bound to the same candidate/current entry.

COD.rationale: Same referent/time contains explicit content coordinates, an origin/representation description, and a separate record/status field.

A.rationale: Origin entries label processing kinds (command_estimate, history_estimate) tied to specific content entries, linking processing condition to content access/organization.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify coordinates for named attributes (red/blue) at named referents/times.

D.rationale: Origin contains separate status fields (record_status, executed_branch_claim) distinct from the content coordinates, providing a status differentiation.

O.rationale: Entries include explicit origin/representation metadata describing how/when the content is represented or accessed.
